target.identity_arguments: p_app_id uuid, p_chapter_id uuid, p_expected_revision integer, p_expected_snapshot jsonb, p_enabled boolean

membershipInterpretation: service_role, authenticated and anon have no parent roles in observed membership graph. authenticator membership permits role selection; it is not service_role inheriting authenticated. Target service_role permission is direct ACL. postgres has owner and explicit ACL rights (not superuser here).
PUBLIC: Pseudo-role assessed using grantee OID 0 in effective ACL; not passed as a nonexistent pg_roles role to has_function_privilege.
ownerGuardDefinition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.is_platform_owner()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select exists (
    select 1
    from public.profiles as profile
    where profile.id = (select auth.uid())
      and profile.global_role = 'platform_owner'
      and profile.role = 'platform_super_admin'
      and coalesce(profile.status, 'active') = 'active'
  );
$function$

WITH f AS (
 SELECT p.*,n.nspname,l.lanname,pg_get_userbyid(p.proowner) AS owner
 FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=p.pronamespace JOIN pg_language l ON l.oid=p.prolang
 WHERE (n.nspname='public' AND p.proname IN ('review_chapter_practice_binding','read_chapter_practice_snapshots','review_teaching_script_source','approve_teaching_script_source')) OR (n.nspname='private' AND p.proname='is_platform_owner')
), rows AS (
 SELECT f.oid::regprocedure::text AS signature,f.nspname AS schema,f.owner,f.lanname AS language,pg_get_function_identity_arguments(f.oid) AS identity_arguments,f.proacl::text AS acl,f.prosecdef AS security_definer,f.provolatile AS volatility,f.proleakproof AS leakproof,f.proparallel AS parallel,f.proconfig AS config,encode(sha256(convert_to(pg_get_functiondef(f.oid),'UTF8')),'hex') AS definition_sha256,
 (SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('grantee',CASE WHEN a.grantee=0 THEN 'PUBLIC' ELSE pg_get_userbyid(a.grantee) END,'grantor',pg_get_userbyid(a.grantor),'privilege',a.privilege_type,'grantable',a.is_grantable)) FROM aclexplode(coalesce(f.proacl,acldefault('f',f.proowner))) a) AS explicit_acl,
 (SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('role',r.rolname,'execute',has_function_privilege(r.oid,f.oid,'EXECUTE'),'owner',r.oid=f.proowner,'superuser',r.rolsuper,'inherits',r.rolinherit,'bypassrls',r.rolbypassrls)) FROM pg_roles r WHERE r.rolname IN ('postgres','authenticated','service_role','anon')) AS privilege_matrix,
 EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM aclexplode(coalesce(f.proacl,acldefault('f',f.proowner))) a WHERE a.grantee=0 AND a.privilege_type='EXECUTE') AS public_execute
 FROM f
) SELECT jsonb_build_object(
 'functions',(SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(rows) ORDER BY signature) FROM rows),
 'defaults',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('owner',pg_get_userbyid(d.defaclrole),'schema',CASE WHEN d.defaclnamespace=0 THEN 'GLOBAL' ELSE (SELECT nspname FROM pg_namespace WHERE oid=d.defaclnamespace) END,'object_type',d.defaclobjtype,'acl',d.defaclacl::text)) FROM pg_default_acl d WHERE d.defaclobjtype='f' AND (d.defaclnamespace=0 OR d.defaclnamespace='public'::regnamespace)),
 'memberships',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('role',pg_get_userbyid(m.roleid),'member',pg_get_userbyid(m.member),'grantor',pg_get_userbyid(m.grantor),'admin_option',m.admin_option)) FROM pg_auth_members m),
 'ownerGuardDefinition',pg_get_functiondef('private.is_platform_owner()'::regprocedure),
 'readOnly',current_setting('transaction_read_only'))
